name: polyomics-search
description: Search PolyOmics, a large-scale computational polymer property database based on molecular simulations. Screen polymer candidates and use published Sim2Real evidence to estimate experimental properties and reason about material performance.

interface.longDescription: Search PolyOmics, a large-scale computational polymer property database based primarily on all-atom molecular dynamics (MD). Find, rank, and compare polymers by simulated properties, polymer classes, and chemical structures. Use applicable published Sim2Real evidence for exploratory experimental-property estimates, simulation-based proxies, and evidence-guided materials design. Distinguish these estimates from measured experimental values and independently validated predictions.
defaultPrompt: Find polymer candidates for a thermally conductive insulating film and assess the experimental evidence.
Estimate experimental density for a PolyOmics candidate if a published Direct fit applies.
Which simulated properties could help screen polymers for low water uptake?
